entities.summary: Jaroslav Otevřel is a Czech former professional ice hockey left winger. Otevrel played 16 NHL games with the San Jose Sharks. In Europe, Otevrel played with his native club AC ZPS Zlin as well as the Slovakian HK Dukla Trencin. Otevrel retired from ice hockey in 1996 after getting paralyzed in a game while representing the Finnish hockey club Porin Ässät.

entities.summary: Jaroslav Otevřel is a Czech former professional ice hockey left winger. Otevrel played 16 NHL games with the San Jose Sharks. In Europe, Otevrel played with his native club AC ZPS Zlin as well as the Slovakian HK Dukla Trencin. Otevrel retired from ice hockey in 1996 after getting paralyzed in a game while representing the Finnish hockey club Porin Ässät.
